Outswing Door Stainless Steel Security Latch Guard

text.description_html:
Don-Jo LP-111-630, Outswing Door Stainless Security Latch Guard

This satin stainless steel security door latch protector is 11" high and designed specifically for outswing doors (door opens out of the room or building). For use with key-in knobs / levers (door knobs or levers that use a key to unlock) on residential or commercial door applications.

Protect your entry doors from tampering and latch prying with this heavy duty stainless steel security latch protector plate. No special tools required for installation. Packaged with mounting hardware.

Also available: Steel Latch Guard in other finish colors.

Non-Handed, reversible for left or right hand outswinging doors. Fits doors with standard 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backset.

Specifications for Don-Jo LP-111-630 Stainless Security Latch Guard

  • Plate Height: 11"
  • Plate Width: 3"
  • Plate Thickness: 12 Gauge (.104")
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Offset: 1/4" (.250")
  • Non-Handed (reversible)
  • Fasteners: 4 each 5/16-18 x 2-1/4" Carriage bolt with Acorn nuts and washers.
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Don-Jo LP-111-630 Security Plate Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold Individually.
